name: get_progress
description: The learner's progress: how many words they know, and their coverage of each JLPT level's words and kanji (N5 to N1).

name: get_mistakes
description: The learner's mistakes queue (Leitner boxes 1-5): words they answered wrongly, with when each is due for review.

name: recommend_words
description: Ten words for the learner to learn next, from Juku's recommender (Susumu), each with the reason it was chosen. Facts only; don't invent other suggestions.

name: find_reading_sentences
description: Up to ten example sentences (from Tatoeba, with furigana) in which the learner knows every word but one, and that one new word.

name: get_plan
description: The learner's pace plan: the words a week needed to reach 80% of their target level and everything easier by their exam date, with the formula.

name: get_recent_activity
description: The learner's activity over the last 7 days, by their local date: quiz answers, correct answers, words marked known, sentences read.

name: get_memory
description: What Shiori remembers about how this learner learns: notes with their evidence. Read-only.

name: search_words
description: Search the JLPT dictionary (OpenJLPT) by kanji, kana, romaji or English. Returns up to ten words with their ID, reading, level and meanings. Contains no learner data.

query.description: What to look up, e.g. 食べる, たべる, taberu or to eat.

name: request_replan
description: Ask Keiko, the planner, for a new weekly plan for this learner. It only queues a run (at most one a day); the plan still passes the critic and code, and the learner decides whether to use it.
